Gus Bilirakis

Gus Michael Bilirakis (born February 8, 1963) is an American lawyer and Republican politician serving as the U.S. representative for Florida's 12th congressional district since 2007.

The son of former U.S. representative Michael Bilirakis, he previously served in the Florida House of Representatives from 1998 to 2006 and practices law in the Tampa Bay area.

Early Life and Education

Gus Bilirakis was born on February 8, 1963, in Gainesville, Florida, as a second-generation Greek-American. His father, Michael Bilirakis, was born in Tarpon Springs.

Bilirakis attended St. Petersburg Junior College from 1981 to 1983 before transferring to the University of Florida, where he earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in 1986. He then pursued legal studies at Stetson University College of Law, obtaining his Juris Doctor in 1989.

Following law school, Bilirakis gained early professional experience through internships and co-founded a law firm specializing in probate and estate planning.

Personal Life

Bilirakis married Eva Lialios. The couple has four sons. The family resides in Florida.
